WITH
, sale_lines AS ( SELECT DISTINCT d.district_code, s.sale_application_id, s.sale_property_id, s.sale_contract_date, s.sale_property_share, s.longitude, s.latitude, s.sale_property_price_aed, s.property_sold_area_sqm, s.property_sale_rate_aed_sqm FROM ods.ods_re_x_q21_matview_sale AS s JOIN districts AS d ON s.longitude BETWEEN d.xmin AND d.xmax AND s.latitude BETWEEN d.ymin AND d.ymax AND ST_Intersects(d.geom, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(s.longitude, s.latitude), #{sourceSrid})) WHERE s.sale_contract_date >= #{previousStartDate} AND s.sale_contract_date < #{periodEndNextDate} AND s.longitude::text NOT IN ('NaN', 'Infinity', '-Infinity') AND s.latitude::text NOT IN ('NaN', 'Infinity', '-Infinity') )
mapper.select: , metric_lines AS ( SELECT district_code, sale_application_id, sale_contract_date >= #{periodStartDate} AS in_current_period, CASE WHEN sale_property_price_aed::text NOT IN ('NaN', 'Infinity', '-Infinity') THEN sale_property_price_aed END AS amount_aed, CASE WHEN property_sold_area_sqm > 0 AND property_sold_area_sqm::text NOT IN ('NaN', 'Infinity', '-Infinity') THEN property_sold_area_sqm END AS area_sqm, CASE WHEN property_sale_rate_aed_sqm::text NOT IN ('NaN', 'Infinity', '-Infinity') THEN property_sale_rate_aed_sqm END AS rate_aed_sqm FROM sale_lines ) SELECT district_code, SUM(amount_aed) FILTER (WHERE in_current_period) AS sales_aed, SUM(amount_aed) FILTER (WHERE NOT in_current_period) AS previous_sales_aed, NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT sale_application_id) FILTER (WHERE in_current_period), 0)::int AS transactions, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER ( WHERE in_current_period AND (area_sqm IS NULL OR rate_aed_sqm IS NULL) ) = 0 THEN SUM(rate_aed_sqm * area_sqm) FILTER (WHERE in_current_period) / NULLIF(SUM(area_sqm) FILTER (WHERE in_current_period), 0) END AS avg_price_sqm FROM metric_lines GROUP BY district_code

SELECT district_code, DATE_TRUNC('month', sale_contract_date)::date AS month, COUNT(DISTINCT sale_application_id)::int AS transactions FROM sale_lines WHERE sale_contract_date >= #{periodStartDate} AND sale_application_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2
mapper.sql: CASE WHEN pg_typeof(${eventTime}) = 'timestamptz'::regtype THEN (${eventTime} AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Dubai')::date ELSE ${eventTime}::date END

CASE WHEN ${coordinates}.longitude::double precision > '-Infinity'::double precision AND ${coordinates}.longitude::double precision < 'Infinity'::double precision AND ${coordinates}.latitude::double precision > '-Infinity'::double precision AND ${coordinates}.latitude::double precision < 'Infinity'::double precision AND (#{sourceSrid} <> 4326 OR (${coordinates}.longitude BETWEEN -180 AND 180 AND ${coordinates}.latitude BETWEEN -90 AND 90)) THEN ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(${coordinates}.longitude, ${coordinates}.latitude), #{sourceSrid}) END
mapper.select:
WITH latest_load AS ( SELECT (SELECT MAX(_ingested_at) FROM ods.ods_re_x_q21_matview_sale WHERE isfinite(_ingested_at)) AS sale_loaded_at, (SELECT MAX(_ingested_at) FROM ods.ods_re_x_q21_matview_mortgage WHERE isfinite(_ingested_at)) AS mortgage_loaded_at, (SELECT MAX(_ingested_at) FROM ods.ods_re_x_q21_matview_rent WHERE isfinite(_ingested_at) AND LOWER(BTRIM(rent_application_source_system)) IN ('tawtheeq', 'adgm')) AS rent_loaded_at ), snapshot_days AS ( SELECT AS sale_snapshot_date,
AS mortgage_snapshot_date,
AS rent_snapshot_date FROM latest_load ) SELECT GREATEST(sale_snapshot_date, mortgage_snapshot_date, rent_snapshot_date) AS source_as_of, rent_snapshot_date FROM snapshot_days

WITH , mortgage_points AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT m.orientational_mortgage_contract_id AS contract_id, AS point FROM ods.ods_re_x_q21_matview_mortgage m WHERE m.mortgage_start_date >= #{periodStartDate} AND m.mortgage_start_date < #{periodEndNextDate} AND LOWER(BTRIM(m.mortgage_application_type)) IN ('registration', 'release', 'change') AND m.orientational_mortgage_contract_id IS NOT NULL ) SELECT d.district_code, COUNT(DISTINCT m.contract_id)::integer AS count FROM mortgage_points m JOIN districts d ON m.point && d.geom AND ST_Intersects(d.geom, m.point) GROUP BY d.district_code

WITH , rent_rows AS ( SELECT LOWER(BTRIM(r.rent_application_source_system)) AS source_system, BTRIM(r.rent_contract_number) AS contract_number, COALESCE(r.rent_property_id, r.property_id) AS property_id, r.latitude, r.longitude, LOWER(BTRIM(r.rent_contract_current_status)) AS status,
AS start_date,
AS end_date,
AS cancellation_date, CASE WHEN isfinite(r._ingested_at) THEN r._ingested_at END AS loaded_at, CASE WHEN isfinite(r.trs_moye_input_time) THEN r.trs_moye_input_time END AS input_time, r.rent_application_date AS application_date FROM ods.ods_re_x_q21_matview_rent r WHERE LOWER(BTRIM(r.rent_application_source_system)) IN ('tawtheeq', 'adgm') AND NULLIF(BTRIM(r.rent_contract_number), '') IS NOT NULL ), versioned AS ( SELECT r.*, DENSE_RANK() OVER ( PARTITION BY source_system, contract_number ORDER BY loaded_at DESC NULLS LAST, input_time DESC NULLS LAST, application_date DESC NULLS LAST ) AS contract_version, DENSE_RANK() OVER ( PARTITION BY source_system, contract_number, property_id, CASE WHEN property_id IS NULL THEN latitude END, CASE WHEN property_id IS NULL THEN longitude END ORDER BY loaded_at DESC NULLS LAST, input_time DESC NULLS LAST, application_date DESC NULLS LAST ) AS property_version FROM rent_rows r ), contract_status AS ( SELECT source_system, contract_number, BOOL_AND(COALESCE( status = 'active' AND isfinite(start_date) AND start_date <= #{rentSnapshotDate} AND isfinite(end_date) AND end_date >= #{rentSnapshotDate} AND (cancellation_date IS NULL OR cancellation_date > #{rentSnapshotDate}), false )) AS active FROM versioned WHERE contract_version = 1 GROUP BY source_system, contract_number ), property_points AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT r.source_system, r.contract_number, AS point FROM versioned r WHERE property_version = 1 ) SELECT d.district_code, (COUNT(DISTINCT (r.source_system, r.contract_number)) FILTER (WHERE c.active))::integer AS count FROM property_points r JOIN districts d ON r.point && d.geom AND ST_Intersects(d.geom, r.point) JOIN contract_status c USING (source_system, contract_number) GROUP BY d.district_code
